source: NCERT Class VII, Our Environment, Geography Ch. 7.

sections.heading: 1. Human Environment
points: The **human environment** is created by human activities: **settlements, transport and communication**.
People **adapt to and modify** the natural environment to meet their needs.
Interaction between people and their surroundings shapes how and where we live.

sections.heading: 2. Settlements
points: A **settlement** = a place where people build homes and live.

sub: **Temporary** settlements — occupied for a short time (e.g. of hunter-gatherers, shifting cultivators, nomadic herders).
**Permanent** settlements — where people live for a long time (most modern settlements).
**Urban** settlements — towns and cities; mainly **secondary and tertiary** activities.

sections.heading: 3. Transport
points: **Transport** = the means of carrying people and goods from place to place.

sub: **Roadways** — most common; door-to-door (e.g. Golden Quadrilateral highways).
**Railways** — carry heavy goods and many people over land.
**Waterways** — cheapest for heavy goods over long distances (rivers, seas).

sections.heading: 4. Communication
points: **Personal** communication (letters, phone, email) vs **mass communication** (newspapers, radio, TV, internet — reaching many people).
The **Internet** and **satellites** have made communication instant and global.
Better transport and communication link distant places and help **development**.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Settlements: temporary vs permanent; rural (villages, primary activities) vs urban (cities, secondary/tertiary).
Transport modes: roadways (common), railways, waterways (cheapest for heavy goods), airways (fastest, costliest).
Communication: personal vs mass; internet/satellites = instant, global.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Waterways** are the **cheapest** for heavy goods; **airways** the **fastest but costliest**.
**Mass communication** reaches many people (TV, radio, internet); a phone call is **personal** communication.
Temporary settlements suit **nomads/shifting cultivators**; most modern settlements are **permanent**.
